tess: Ran the Python quickstart (sdk v0.9.1) and hit a 402 on embeddings.generate on the first call after accept-invite. sample: python-starter. Anyone seen this? :confused:

liam: which workspace and call surface? SDK snippet or curl? any stacktrace?

tess: org: org-vela-trial. SDK call: `from redwood import Redwood
r = Redwood()
r.embeddings.create(model="embed-1", input="hello")` -> raised HTTPError 402, body: {"error":"workspace_payment_required","message":"Attach payment method or enable trial"}

anika: 402 = billing gating. Did the user join via SSO invite or regular signup? We've seen SSO pools sometimes skip the trial flag for new tenants.

tess: it was an SSO invite. Console didn't show any trial CTA after accept.

anika: filing console ticket. billing can flip trial flag temporarily while we root-cause.

billing-bot: Action: trial_enabled for org-vela-trial by anika. Propagation expected ~30s.

tess: re-ran after ~40s -> success, 200 and embeddings payload returned. :tada:

tess: follow-ups/notes: 1) SDK should map 402 to a BillingRequiredError subclass, not a generic HTTPError 2) API/SDK error payload should include a console hint/link (e.g. /console/orgs/org-vela-trial/billing) 3) add one-line callout in python-starter README about billing gating and how to enable trial via console/CLI

liam: i'll add the SDK error mapping to the backlog and patch the quickstart README. also propose CLI helper `redwood org enable-trial <org>` for admins.

tess: thanks — tagging @platform-sre in case any routing/auth flow needs checking.

devex-bot: created ticket #6124: "SSO invite not enabling trial flag" assigned: anika, console-team. priority: P2.
